narrative: Unsloth Studio's June build pushes the local stack from train-and-chat into MCP-connected agent territory: a locally-served Gemma 4 or Qwen3.6 model calls Context7, Exa, and Hugging Face tools autonomously in one thread, closing the fine-tune to tool-using-agent loop on owned hardware and confirming capable agent behavior runs locally by default.
remaining_gap: No cloud-overflow handoff: the build is a self-contained local workbench, not a coding-agent harness that spills to cloud as overflow.
